capabilities: Import Kobo highlights from the device's KoboReader.sqlite database over USB
Append new highlights to existing notes without rewriting them
Generate one note per book with frontmatter, chapter headings, and position markers
Back up the Kobo database before each sync, keeping the 10 most recent
Divert new highlights to a linked continuation note for books in protected folders
disambiguation: One-way import only: 'sync' means importing new highlights from the device, not two-way syncing with the e-reader.
extras: Desktop-only (default paths are for macOS; Windows and Linux need manual path setup). Makes no network requests. Highlights with attached notes are not imported yet. Localized to Chinese and English.
motivation: Other Kobo importers regenerate the whole note on every import, so anything the user adds to it can be lost; this plugin was built to import without rewriting.
problem: Other Kobo importers regenerate the whole note on every import, so edits a user makes to imported highlights can be lost.

requires.name: Kobo e-reader connected over USB (desktop only)

summary: Imports Kobo e-reader highlights from the device database into vault notes, appending new highlights without ever rewriting existing notes.
